tideAmplitude.description: Tidal water level range driven by moon phase

snowLevelSeasonal.description: How much snow line drops in winter (height units)

useViewportMesh.description: Use rolling viewport mesh (disable for shoreline subdivision)

shorelineSubdivision.description: Subdivide shoreline tiles where angles are steep (0=off, 1=medium, 2=high)

terrainSunOrbitScale.description: Multiplier for the primary orbit height influence (sun) when generating terrain

terrainMoonOrbitScale.description: Multiplier for the secondary orbit height influence (moon) when generating terrain

terrainOuterRingScale.description: Scale the outer terrain ring radius (1=default, 4=4x distance to horizon)

waveEnabled.description: Enable water wave animation (shader-based, flat plane)

waveAmplitude.description: Large wave amplitude for normal perturbation

waveSteepness.description: Large wave crest sharpness (0 = smooth, 1 = sharp)

waveTexNormal.description: How much the procedural waves perturb surface normals

waveWindFactor.description: How much wind affects wave texture animation speed

waterWindDirX.description: Wind direction X component (affects procedural wave flow)

waterWindDirZ.description: Wind direction Z component (affects procedural wave flow)

shoreLagTime.description: Seconds for shore wet line to catch up to changing water level (higher = slower)

waterSize.description: Water plane size in world units (0.5x terrain grid size)

waterResolution.description: Water mesh grid resolution (verts per axis, terrain-matched default)

waveSparkle.description: Intensity of moving sparkle highlights on wave peaks

waveFresnelPower.description: Reflection edge falloff sharpness (higher = sharper edges)

waveNormalEps.description: Normal computation step size (lower = sharper, bumpier normals)

planetWrapRadius.description: Coordinate wrap radius from planet center

deformStartHeight.description: Camera height where spherical deformation begins

deformEndHeight.description: Camera height where deformation is fully spherical

windExposureScale.description: Terrain exposure wind multiplier (higher = more wind on exposed trees)

windShadowStrength.description: Wind shadow strength (leeward vs windward tree multiplier)

windHeightPower.description: Wind bend height power (how much tree top bends vs base)

blusteryWind.description: Random blustery wind (0 = calm steady, 10 = changeable direction fluctuating gale force)

windSoundEnabled.description: Enable wind ambience and gust swoosh audio

windDebrisEnabled.description: Enable flying leaf/twig/dust debris particles in wind

windDebrisDensity.description: Multiplier for wind debris particle count

windParticleColor.description: Base color for leaf and dust particles

windParticleGravity.description: Gravity multiplier for debris (0 = weightless, 1 = normal, 2 = heavy)

windTwigFrequency.description: Chance of spawning a twig instead of a leaf (0 = none, 1 = all twigs)

windTwigGravity.description: How fast twigs fall relative to leaves (higher = sinks faster)

windGravityFactor.description: How much low wind increases gravity (0 = constant gravity, 1 = calm air lets debris fall, 2 = strong drop in calm)

fogGradientEnabled.description: Enable enhanced fog gradient (custom falloff curve)

fogColorBandCount.description: Number of fog gradient color bands

fogColorStop1.description: Normalized stop position for near color

fogColorStop2.description: Normalized stop position for color band 2

fogColorStop3.description: Normalized stop position for color band 3

fogColorStop4.description: Normalized stop position for color band 4

fogColorStop5.description: Normalized stop position for far color

grassWindMultiplier.description: Grass wind displacement strength multiplier (scales global wind)

grassSharpness.description: Grass blade edge sharpness (0 = soft/cloudy, 1 = hard blades)

grassWindSpeed.description: Grass wind animation speed (higher = faster waves)

grassPhaseScale.description: Wind spatial wavelength scale (lower = broader waves)

forestEnabled.description: Enable biome-dependent forest floor textures under trees

forestBlendMax.description: Maximum strength of forest floor takeover where trees are dense

forestMaskStrength.description: How strongly the tree-density mask is emphasized (higher = tighter patches)

forestBiomeBias.description: Bias toward forest biomes (higher = only strong forest zones get the texture)

forestTexScale.description: Forest floor texture tiling scale (smaller = finer detail)

forestNoiseScale.description: Breakup noise scale for mask edges (higher = noisier blend)

forestBaseInfluence.description: Baseline forest-floor influence even with sparse trees (helps subtle duff)

beachStoneAmount.description: Amount of stone patches vs pure sand

beachStoneScale.description: Noise scale for stone/sand variation (smaller = broader patches)

beachWetWidth.description: Width of the high-tide wet sand band above water

beachWetIntensity.description: Darkness of the wet sand high-tide line

wetFadeDelay.description: Distance above water where sand stays fully wet before fading

wetFadeSpeed.description: How quickly wet sand dries out above the plateau zone

beachShrubAmount.description: Amount of hardy shrubbery at the top of the beach

beachBiomeBias.description: Bias toward true biome beach weight (higher = only strong beach zones render)

beachHeightBlend.description: Blend additional height-based mask with biome weight (0 = biome only)

cliffEnabled.description: Enable cliff material on steep slopes

cliffThreshold.description: Slope angle where cliff material starts (0=flat, 1=vertical)

cliffRubbleAmount.description: Loose scree / rubble visibility on cliff faces

cliffMossAmount.description: Moss coverage on less-vertical cliff faces

biomeEdgeA.description: First biome in the edge pair (modifier stack target)

biomeEdgeB.description: Second biome in the edge pair (modifier stack target)

biomePatchScale.description: Patch noise spatial scale (smaller = bigger patches)

biomePatchStrength.description: Patch noise threshold shift strength (0 = off)

biomeTexScale0_0.description: Deep Water base layer UV scale

biomeTexScale1_0.description: Deep Water overlay layer UV scale

biomeTexNoiseScale_0.description: Deep Water layer 1 noise mask scale

biomeTexScale0_1.description: Shallow Water base layer UV scale

biomeTexScale1_1.description: Shallow Water overlay layer UV scale

biomeTexNoiseScale_1.description: Shallow Water layer 1 noise mask scale

biomeTextureBlend.description: How much real PBR biome textures blend into procedural color (0 = procedural only, 1 = full texture)

biomeModifierStack.description: Layered noise modifiers for biome surface edges

checkerFadeStrength.description: Checkerboard transparency fade strength (0 = full checkerboard, 1 = full biome)

checkerboardEnabled.description: Enable checkerboard pattern (disabled = full biome texture)

taaFeedbackLow.description: History weight when motion is calm (higher = softer edges)

taaFeedbackHigh.description: History weight when motion spikes (higher = smoother but blurrier)

taaClampScalar.description: Neighborhood clamp scalar (higher clamps ghosting more aggressively)

taaJitterSpread.description: Subpixel jitter spread (higher = faster convergence, but more shimmer)

taaSharpenStrength.description: Post-resolve sharpening to recover fine detail

flareSpread.description: How far flares spread along the sun-camera axis

minimapEdgeFade.description: Fade minimap chunks at the edge of explored area

minimapFadeDepth.description: How many chunk rings deep the edge fade goes (0 = no fade)

minimapCircularMask.description: Apply circular soft-edge mask to the whole minimap

minimapMaskStart.description: Where the circular mask fade begins (fraction of radius)

minimapContourFade.description: Fade only chunks at the actual boundary of explored area

minimapContourOpacity.description: Opacity of chunks on the very edge (interior is always 1.0)

minimapUpdateInterval.description: Minimap redraw throttle interval in ms (lower = faster updates)

treeType.description: Override all trees to one type

treeWindSensitivity.description: How much trees react to global wind speed (multiplier)

treeDensityMultiplier.description: Global multiplier for all biome tree densities (0 = no trees, 5 = 5x density)

treeMinSlope.description: Reduce minimum slope requirement for tree spawning (higher = more flat-land trees)

flatTreeDensity.description: Random flat-terrain tree density as fraction of biome density (0 = only slope trees)

treeUpright.description: Keep trees vertical instead of tilting to terrain normal

scrollEffectStartHeight.description: Height above terrain where drag-speed scaling begins

scrollBaseDragSpeed.description: Base right-click / touch drag pan speed

scrollHeightMultiplier.description: Extra drag speed per world unit above start height

skyFadeStartHeight.description: Camera height where stars start appearing

skyFadeEndHeight.description: Camera height where stars are fully visible

skyTransparency.description: Atmospheric sky transparency (0 = orbit/space, 1 = full atmosphere)

skyEnabled.description: Enable starfield shader (disable to use canvas sky)

jesusLift.description: Target lift height for Jesus summon hill

pieceModelOverrides.description: GLB model overrides for chess pieces

cursorDistanceScale.description: Scale cursor size based on camera height

cursorDistanceNear.description: Camera orbit distance where cursor stays full size

cursorDistanceFar.description: Camera orbit distance where cursor reaches min scale

cursorDistanceMinScale.description: Cursor scale multiplier at far distance

cursorSpeedSize.description: Cursor size boost from speed (0 = no boost)

cursorWingSpeedScale.description: Shrink wings when stationary and expand with speed

cursorWingScaleMult.description: Max wing scale at full speed

cursorGrabDisableSpeedScale.description: Disable cursor speed-scale growth while left-click dragging

cursorGrabSlowFactor.description: Camera pan speed multiplier while left-click dragging (lower = heavier feel)

cursorGrabBuzzIntensity.description: Buzz volume/intensity multiplier while dragging (effort sound)

cursorBuzzVolume.description: Base volume of the cursor buzz sound

cursorBuzzFadeNear.description: Camera distance where buzz volume fade begins

cursorBuzzFadeFar.description: Camera distance where buzz reaches minimum volume

cursorDragSpeedCap.description: Maximum right-click drag pan speed (hard cap)

cursorDragCutoffDistance.description: Maximum world distance the camera can pan during a right-click drag

cursorDragMomentum.description: Camera coasting momentum after releasing a right-click drag (0 = no coasting)

cursorIdleRadius.description: Max orbit radius of idle local-space hover (px)

cursorIdleSpeed.description: Speed multiplier for idle spherical flight

cursorDrownSubmergeMs.description: Drowning: time to dip under water (ms)

cursorDrownEmergeMs.description: Drowning: time to rise back to surface (ms)

cursorDrownFlyUpMs.description: Drowning: time to fly up above water (ms)

cursorDrownHarumphMs.description: Drowning: harumph TTS pause before ending (ms)

cursorDrownShakeCycles.description: Drowning: number of wet-dog shake cycles

cursorDrownSubmergeDepth.description: Drowning: how far the sprite dips (px)

cursorDrownFlyHeight.description: Drowning: how high the sprite flies above water (px)

cursorSubmergedOverlay.description: Underwater: blue water overlay opacity while submerged

cursorUnderwaterSpeed.description: Underwater: cursor follow speed (lower = heavier feel)

weatherFrontThreshold.description: Distance (world units) at which opposite pressure agents deform rings and show front symbols

weatherSymbolCutoff.description: Multiplier for symbol visibility gate (lower = symbols stay visible from further away)

weatherRingScale.description: Visual scale multiplier for isobar ring radii on the minimap

weatherSpawnRadius.description: Radius (world units) for debug weather agent spawning around player

weatherSpawnCount.description: Number of agents to spawn per debug spawn click

climateAgentCount.description: Target number of climate agents in the environmental simulation

weatherMoveScale.description: Multiplier for agent movement range. Higher = larger weather patterns

weatherSampleCount.description: Number of squares sampled per agent move. Lower = more directed movement

weatherFogDensityScale.description: Multiplier for fog plane density from weather snapshot

weatherCloudCoverageScale.description: Multiplier for sky cloud coverage / overcast darkening

voxelCloudRenderRadius.description: Cloud render radius in grid cells

voxelCloudProximityFade.description: Distance at which cloud billboards fade in from camera

fogPlaneRadius.description: Fog plane outer circular mask radius

fogPlaneInnerRadius.description: Fog plane inner radius where circular fade begins

fogPlaneDistTransparency.description: Distance transparency strength (0 = uniform opacity, 1 = full near-far fade)

fogPlaneWindFade.description: How much wind blows fog away

fogPlaneNoiseScale.description: Noise UV scale for fog splatter pattern
